transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose things just got a little out of hand lately. Um... with the historical society. 

I took on their project—the fundraiser—and... I guess I acted like I could just run the whole thing myself. I started making all these quilt designs, calling up volunteers, drawing up schedules... promising deadlines I couldn't possibly meet. So... that's why I'm here.
Did you feel like you were the only one who really knew how to get the project done correctly?

I suppose I did, yes. I just... well, I really believed my heritage quilt ideas were going to put our little town on the map. It felt like I had finally found the thing that only I could make happen. So... yes.
Did you feel like your ideas for the heritage quilt were significantly better than anyone else's?

Well... yes. I mean, like I just said... I really thought my designs were what would finally get the town noticed. I didn't really stop to look at anyone else's work. I just... I believed I was the only one who could make it happen.
Have you often found yourself taking charge of projects or groups in the past?
Um... no. Not really. I usually just... stay in the background. I don't really do that sort of thing normally.
Have you always felt like you're better than others or is this something that's developed more recently?
Um... no, I don't... I don't think I'm better than people. I've never really felt like that before. It was just... recently, I guess. With the quilts. I don't usually think that way at all.
Have you always acted this way when working on projects, or is this something new for you?
I... I think I just said that. It's new. I've never acted like that before. I usually just keep to myself.
Do you often find yourself feeling like you have a special destiny or that you're meant for great things?

I don't... I wouldn't use a word like destiny. That sounds... I don't know. But... I guess, with the heritage quilts... I did truly believe my ideas were going to put our little town on the map. It just felt like... like I had finally found the one thing that only I could make happen. But like I said, that's not how I usually am.
Have you recently started expecting special treatment or automatic compliance from others?
No, I... I don't think so. I don't expect special treatment from anybody. I just wanted them to help with the quilts, that's all.
Have you ever received feedback from others that you can be overly controlling or dominant in group settings before this quilt project?
No. I... people don't usually say much to me at all. Like I said, I mostly just keep to myself. I don't really do group things.
Do you still believe your heritage quilt ideas are going to put your town on the map?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really looked at any of it lately. I guess... I don't know, it was just a project. I don't really know what I was thinking, honestly.
Have you ever been told by someone that you have difficulty listening to others or considering their opinions?
No... not really. Like I said, I don't talk to people much anyway, so... there's not really anyone to tell me that. I just do my own thing.
Do you feel like you're more important than other people in your community?

No... not really. I mean... I guess for a little while, with the quilts... I really did think my ideas were going to put our little town on the map. I felt like... like I had finally found the one thing that only I could make happen. But... I don't think like that normally.
Have you been feeling unusually self-important or superior to others outside of the quilt project?
No. Just the quilts. I don't... I don't really think about myself like that.
Have you ever had a period like this before, where you felt like you could accomplish something big and you took charge of it?
No... I don't think so. Just this time.
Have you ever had feelings of entitlement or expected special favors from others in your daily life?
No... I don't think so. I don't really expect people to... treat me any differently than anyone else.
Did you feel like you deserved special recognition or praise for your work on the quilt project?
No... not really. I just wanted to get it done. It wasn't about praise, I just... I needed to finish it.
Have you ever had a close relationship where someone told you that you were being selfish or only thinking of yourself?
No... I don't think anyone's ever said that to me. I mean, my relationships are pretty normal, I guess. I try to be considerate.
Do you often find yourself being envious of others or feeling like others are envious of you?
No... I don't really think about things like that. I just try to mind my own business, mostly. And I doubt anyone is jealous of me.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt as self-assured and confident as you did with the quilt project?

Well... I suppose there was a time recently. While I was working on that quilt. I just... I really thought my ideas for it were going to put our little town on the map, you know? Like I had finally found this one thing that... that only I could make happen. But... I don't know. It's just a quilt, I guess.
Do you think your behavior with the quilt project was an isolated incident or part of a larger pattern in your life?
I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't really thought about it like that. I just made a quilt. I don't think it's a pattern of anything.
